TOOL: gh pr view 77 --json title,body,author,files,additions,deletions,statusCheckRollup,mergeStateStatus

TOOL: gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators --jq '.[] | select(.permissions.maintain or .permissions.admin or .permissions.push) | .login + " " + (.permissions|tostring)'
